messages:
zoe: Quick RFC follow-up: I prototyped a small compat proxy that wraps legacy streaming frames into a minimal envelope so the v3 runtime can consume them without changing core handlers. Idea is to gate it behind a tenant opt-in flag and a canary. Thoughts?
liam: Love the minimal approach. Major flag: streaming integrity. If we buffer to reframe, we might increase tail latency and break early-consumption clients. Need non-buffering path when possible.
devops_bot: canary scheduled: compat-envelope-canary -> staging at 02:00 UTC :zap:
mia: Non-buffering path SGTM. Plan: if incoming chunk already matches new framing, pass through. If it's legacy, transform headers only and forward chunk bytes as-is. No re-encode.
ops_oncall: Add an emergency-fail-open. If p95 latency for compat proxy > 300ms for 3m OR error_rate > 0.8% then return 429 with `Retry-After` and header `X-RI-Compat-Status: degraded`. Also add a circuit-recovery cooldown.\e: (reaction) :thumbsup:
zoe: Thanks. Also propose header opt-in: `X-RI-Compat: enable=v1`. Default OFF. Rollout timeline suggestion: 1) 2 weeks opt-in canary; 2) enable warning-only opt-out header for 2 weeks; 3) final block and tenant notice after 6 weeks.
liam: Make sure we log trace label `compat.proxy=true` and include tenant_id in span for postmortemability.
mia: Telemetry: counters for `compat.requests`, `compat.transformed`, `compat.passed_through`, plus latency histograms. We'll add a dashboard with p50/p95 and streaming-frame-drop checks.
zoe: Envelope example (keeps body binary): ```json
{"compat_version":"v1","headers":{"orig_shape":"legacy-frame","recv_ts":"<iso>"},"body":<raw-chunk>}
```
liam: Nice. Add unit tests for out-of-order chunks and partial chunks — simulation of flaky networks. Also add integration smoke: 0.5% traffic on canary, compare token stream equality to native v3 handler for a handful of prompt families.
ops_oncall: Also include a TTL on the feature flag. Max lifetime 180 days. Send automated tenant pings at 120, 60, 30 days remaining.
zoe: I'll open the rollout GH issue with checklist: canary config, smoke tests, CB rules, dashboards, tenant notifications, docs blurb. Assign owners: liam (tests), mia (dashboards/alerts), ops_oncall (sre runbook).
liam: I'll draft the small benchmark measuring reframe overhead: measure p50/p95 delta, memory churn, and streaming stall counts.
mia: I'll add alerts: compat.proxy.p95 > baseline +30ms -> page, error_rate > 0.5% -> page. Also alert if `compat.transformed` spikes unexpectedly.
zoe: Good. If no objections I'll start the canary next Wednesday. :shipit:
liam: No objections from me.
ops_oncall: Ready on-call for canary window.
zoe: Thanks everyone, will post the GH link when created.
